01Rent

Renting a home in Madrid

Good homes go fast. We search with your brief, arrange viewings and check the contract before you sign.

  1. 1

    No agency fee for you

    Under the 2023 housing law, the landlord pays the agency commission on a home rental.

  2. 2

    A clear deposit

    The legal deposit is one month of rent. A landlord may ask for up to two more months as an extra guarantee.

  3. 3

    A contract you understand

    We go through each clause with you, in your language, before you sign.

02Buy

Buying a home in Spain

From choosing the area to the notary, with Spanish lawyers checking the contract and papers.

  1. 1

    An NIE is enough

    You can buy with just a foreigner identity number (NIE). Residency is not required.

  2. 2

    Buying does not give residency

    The investor Golden Visa ended on 3 April 2025. If you want to live here, we pair the purchase with a residency route.

  3. 3

    Transfer tax and fees

    On a resale home you pay transfer tax (ITP), set by each region. Notary, registry and legal fees add about 2%.

Transfer tax by region

6%Madrid
7%Andalucía
10%Valencia
10%Cataluña

General guidance, not legal advice. Rules change, so we confirm the figures for your case.
